name: neon-snake
description: Monorepo of the Neon Snake game, its analytics backend and dashboard, and the contract they share.

scripts.dev: concurrently --names api,game,dashboard --prefix-colors blue,green,cyan "pnpm --filter ./backend dev" "VITE_ANALYTICS_URL=http://localhost:3000/api/events pnpm --filter ./game dev" "pnpm --filter ./dashboard dev"
